name: Julietta Thorndike
original_name: ジュリエッタ・ソーンダイク
source:
2nd Lieutenant Julietta Thorndike is the Commando Squad Leader on the moon base. She was trained by [url=https://vndb.org/c14809]Sergeant Jackie Kaminski[/url] at the Military Academy. She is physically competent and keeps the commando squad on the base in top shape. While the model of physical fitness, she's really ignorant when it comes to technical matters. This makes it virtually impossible for her to be the saboteur on the base but nobody will be written off as suspicious by [url=https://vndb.org/c14801]Captain Leiji[/url].

[Edited from [url=http://engbishoujo.tripod.com/criticalprofiles.html]Game's Manual[/url] and [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/562753-critical-point/faqs/19503]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
